scope: One self-contained future test file; only private candidate authoring occurred.

workspace.unregulated: Explicit new empty workspace, no .amc/config/plan/registry/keys/vault initialization or invalid-workspace negative. Fourth argument is passed explicitly; existing checkScopedEgress remains the only product preflight.
workspace.cleanup: rmSync of only that mkdtemp root in finally; errors retained.

http.binding: 127.0.0.1 exact literal, ephemeral port, standard node:http only.
http.requestCapture: Method, path/query, headers and real body collected outside handler assertions; each request/response close Promise is attached immediately.
http.terminals: Socket close Promise attached at connection; request end/aborted/close and response finish/close/error retained; listener started/closed flags asserted after ordinary close.
http.finiteResponses: Every non-stall response ends with accurate Content-Length and Connection: close. Handler errors are captured; finite 500/error end attempted without discarding the original.
http.expectedPeerErrors: Only ECONNRESET/EPIPE on a response explicitly marked allowPeerAbort for the concrete oversize/stall route. Original error objects remain in the owned error records; other errors fail cleanup.
http.cleanup: Stop accepting via one ordinary server.close callback, await all tracked natural request/response/socket terminals, assert closure facts, and remove owned root. No destroy/closeAllConnections/retry/forced signal/timer replacement.
http.setupFailure: Server and error/connection listeners exist before workspace/listen setup. A failed bind/setup is primary; acquired resources remain referenced for finally.
http.noUniversalIsolation: The client does not expose its ClientRequest; no hidden-client-handle, worker-environment, native/key-erasure, detached-descendant, universal OS/TCP or continuous-isolation claim.

errors.solePrimary: Rethrow the original caught value unchanged if no cleanup errors.
errors.combined: AggregateError([primary, ...cleanupErrors]) only when cleanup contributes actual additional errors; cleanup-only errors aggregate.
errors.setup: Persistent server error observer plus rejecting listen error listener; no swallowed bind/setup error.

deadlines.client: All postTimestampQuery calls pass undefined timeoutMs; TSA_TIMEOUT_MS is asserted equal to literal 10000 in the stall body.
deadlines.vitest: No per-test timeout argument or config change; current 30000 ms default remains.
deadlines.stall: No response headers/body/end; await real client abort, then natural peer closure. Capture measured elapsedMs in one safe console record, with no scheduling-bound or DNS/fallback duration inference.

guardBoundary: No environment opt-out, mock, shortened timer, DNS/TLS change, public TSA, source/guard change or F37 continuation. Actual unchanged guard refusal must remain a failure.
